points.description: States that a circular (ring/wrap-around) array is used to implement the queue.
Front of the queue is kept toward the beginning of the array and the rear toward the end (front and rear pointers/indices track the two ends).
The rear pointer is allowed to wrap around to the start of the array when it reaches the end (e.g. using modulo), reusing freed space.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating a circular array with front near the start, rear near the end, and rear wrapping around. Equivalent wording (e.g. modulo arithmetic, ring buffer) earns marks. A plain non-circular array with no wrap-around earns at most the P2 mark.
